page.layout: One column of running text, left block with the running head and page number above it. Catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes.
page.notes: Catchword "for-" is set at the lower right and is left out of the text. Scan edge marks and specks at the bottom and right are not printed text and are omitted. Accents and macrons (certamé, solū, duellorum) are transcribed as they appear on the scan; the macron on "duellorum" is faint and may be a stroke over the u, read here as plain "duellorum". Line-end hyphens are kept where printed (digladia-, gladiato-, mu-, stratage-, evita-, per-, ma-, licen-, tenéren-).
